artifact_schema.description: The discrete logarithm, as 6 lowercase hex characters.

k.description: k with [k]P = Q, in [1, n), zero-padded to exactly 6 lowercase hex characters.

statement: Find k with [k]P = Q on the 21-bit Koblitz instance in examples/certicom-ecdlp/jobs/ecc2k-23.json (job id c22d2033b98a00dbf6635349d70278294c654a6f717c54389c217cde448099f6). The answer half of the toy orbit-rho pair: objective-ecc2k-23-orbit-batch.json pays for the search, this one pays for the answer. Submit {"k"} as 6 lowercase hex characters, k in [1, n). The instance was minted with a known k so a demo can check the recovered logarithm rather than believe it; that is what makes it a test and not a challenge.
